'''Millipods''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]].<ref name="M6" /> The insects' shells were fire-red in [[Color/Legends|color]] and they dwelt in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], where they were raised as a food source by the indigenous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] species.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|314|millipod}}</ref> When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] traveled to Kubindi in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he saw millipods wallowing in a bog as he flew above the surface of the planet in his [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Punishing One/Legends|''Punishing One'']].<ref name="M6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Millipods first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Missions 6: The Search for Grubba the Hutt]]'', a [[1998]] novel written by [[Dave Wolverton]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars Missions]]'' series.<ref name="M6" />
